description: Corrected authority labeling. api_verified=CONFIRMED_FROM_PROGRAMCS renamed to PROGRAMCS_USAGE_CONFIRMED. Added programcs_api_usage_verified (bool) and package_api_authority (bool). PROGRAMCS_USAGE_CONFIRMED does NOT imply package API authority.
